actions.description: Adjust a brand option: Makes one of the captured brand's options again with changed engine settings, when the person says it is not quite right ("a bit darker", "less orange", "greyer backgrounds"). Only the settings given change; earlier adjustments to the option are kept. The engine refits the result to the contrast rules, so never pick colours yourself. hueShift: degrees (-30 to 30) to rotate the brand hue. chromaScale: colour strength (0.5 muted to 1.5 vivid; 1 as found). neutralTint: how much greys and backgrounds take the brand hue (0 pure grey to 2). stateHarmony: how far status colours lean to the brand (0 to 1). groundLight: page lightness in light (0.94 to 1). groundDark: page lightness in dark (0.1 deep to 0.26). Returns the new colours and any rules to review; the person still chooses. (An option's Adjust this option sliders in the Brand and style panel)
